description: Motorola Signature 27 was showcased during an event on Monday, and here are my first impressions of the upcoming flagship smartphone. Finally, Motorola has taken a bold step to redesign the back of one of its smartphones. The rear panel of the Motorola Signature 27 feels like a breath of fresh air. The handset gets a horizontal camera module, with a unique camera lens placement. The deco is divided into two parts. At the top, you see a striped band with three camera sensors. Below it, a metal band runs across the panel, featuring another camera sensor, the Bang & Olufsen branding, and the LED flash.
title: Motorola Signature 27 First Impressions

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is reportedly crashing for some players on PS5. Users are reportedly experiencing repeated crashes with error code CE-108255-1 on the console. Players have reported experiencing the issue in the game's prologue and even in an early mission. The crashes are also stopping some players from progressing in the main story.
title: GTA 6 Reportedly Crashing and Blocking Story Progress for Some PS5 Users; Rockstar Releases Update

description: Solana has introduced solana.ai, a platform offering developers tools to build autonomous AI agents that can carry out blockchain transactions, manage wallets, and purchase online services. Its toolkit includes the open-source Solana Agent Kit, a Model Context Protocol server, and an agent registry. The launch follows growing AI development within the Solana ecosystem, with more than 120 teams reportedly working on related products.
title: Solana Introduces Solana.ai to Support Autonomous AI Agents and Payments

description: OnePlus could be preparing a major display upgrade for its next flagship smartphone. A new leak suggests that next year's OnePlus 17 will feature a widescreen panel with a refresh rate of up to 240Hz. The development follows an earlier claim by tipster Digital Chat Station, who suggested that an upcoming OnePlus handset could feature a 2K resolution display with a 240Hz refresh rate.
title: OnePlus 17 Tipped to Feature Wide-Screen With High Refresh Rate

description: Chainflip has offered the attacker behind a $12 million cryptocurrency theft a 10 percent bounty in exchange for returning 90 percent of the stolen assets by November 23. The protocol has specified repayment amounts in Bitcoin and Ether and said it would withdraw its law enforcement complaints if the funds arrive on time. Its investigation has also identified a server linked to the attack and the mechanism behind the key exposure.
title: Chainflip Offers $1.2 Million Bounty to Return Funds Stolen in $12 Million Attack

description: Samsung appears to be preparing a successor to the Galaxy Fit 3. The upcoming Samsung Galaxy Fit4 has already surfaced in the company's smartphone companion app, and a new report has revealed its expected European pricing and colour options. The fitness tracker is tipped to arrive with a price tag of EUR 79.90 (roughly Rs. 8,000) in France.
title: Samsung Galaxy Fit 4 Price Leaked Ahead of Launch, Could Cost More Than Predecessor

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 reached day one sales of $3.79 billion, Rockstar Games and Take-Two have confirmed. The game has become the biggest entertainment launch of all time, beating top-grossing movies like Avengers: Endgame and Spider-Man: Brand New Day and its predecessor, Grand Theft Auto 5.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Reaches Day One Sales of $3.79 Billion, Shatters Entertainment Records

description: TRIGGR marked its foray into India’s gaming peripherals market with the launch of its first gaming controller called the Striker Wireless Gaming Controller. According to the company, it offers tri-mode connectivity and support for multiple platforms, including PC, PS4, Android, iOS and Steam. The controller features Hall Effect joysticks, custom macro keys and a Turbo Mode. The TRIGGR Striker Wireless Gaming Controller is claimed to offer up to 10 hours of battery life on a single charge.
title: TRIGGR Striker Wireless Gaming Controller Launched in India With Hall Effect Joysticks: Price, Specifications

description: Google’s latest search data points to changing travel interests across India, from outdoor experiences and wellness breaks to shorter holidays and independent trips. Searches for "hidden gems india" rose by 400 percent, while "wellness travel india" climbed by 1,600 percent. One-day trip searches increased by 130 percent, and interest in travel communities across India grew by 400 percent. Google also reported a 600 percent rise in searches for "AI for Travel", alongside stronger interest in pet-friendly hotels and affordable homestays.
title: Google Reveals What Indians Want From Their Holidays in 2026, and It's Not Just Popular Tourist Spots

description: Samsung is reportedly preparing to launch the Galaxy A38 5G and Galaxy A58 smartphones in 2027. Ahead of their expected debut, import and export records on the NBD database have revealed details about the primary rear camera sensors. The Galaxy A58 could retain the camera hardware used by its predecessor, while the Galaxy A38 may feature a different sensor.
title: Samsung Galaxy A38, Galaxy A58 Camera Details Leak via Alleged NBD Listing

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 series RAM and storage configurations have surfaced online. The Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and Galaxy S27 Ultra will reportedly be offered in 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB RAM and storage configurations. Interestingly, it appears that the South Korean tech giant will reserve the faster RAM and storage options for the higher-end variants. For reference, the leaker claims that the 16GB + 1TB model of the Galaxy S27 Pro will be the only variant to get LPDDR6 RAM and UFS5.0 onboard storage. Similarly, the 12GB + 512GB and 16GB + 1TB configurations of the Galaxy S27 Ultra are said to feature the same faster LPDDR6 RAM and UFS5.0 storage. However, since the tech giant has yet to confirm these details, one must read this with a pinch of salt.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Will Reserve Faster RAM for More Expensive Models, Leaked  Storage Configurations Suggest

description: A tipster has shared details of a possible Lock Screen change for Apple's first foldable iPhone. The proposed Complication Column would add two circular widgets above the camera and flashlight shortcuts, alongside the existing widget row. The feature reportedly appears in an internal iOS 27.1 setting but remains inactive. The report comes as Apple rolls out iPhone Duo software changes and details of a successor are beginning to emerge, including possible camera, design and button upgrades for a 2027 launch.
title: iPhone Duo Tipped to Get New Lock Screen Widget Layout in Future iOS 27 Update

description: GrapheneOS has demonstrated an experimental RCS messaging client that supports encrypted conversations across Google Messages and iOS. The app uses the Messaging Layer Security protocol and includes features such as read receipts, typing indicators, reactions and file sharing. While the initial version will require sandboxed Google Play, it will not need Google Messages to function. The developers also plan to support carriers that offer RCS independently of Google's services and are exploring additional safeguards for incoming media attachments.
title: GrapheneOS Could Bring Encrypted RCS Messaging to Its Built-in Messaging App

description: Samsung is said to be developing a new Galaxy AI feature that makes it easier for users to turn their photos and videos into short, shareable clips. According to a report, the Shorts feature was discovered in the latest One UI 9.5 beta update for the Galaxy S26 series. It is reportedly being developed for the Gallery app and may offer both automatic and prompt-based video creation options for creating videos.
title: Samsung’s Shorts Feature Spotted in One UI 9.5 Beta That Turns Photos Into Shareable Short Videos: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro has reportedly received certification on the BIS website in India. The listing carries the model number SM-S957B. While the certification does not reveal any hardware details, it suggests that Samsung is preparing the device for an Indian launch. It could feature a 6.47-inch M16 OLED display with 2K resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro Gets BIS Certification, India Launch Expected Soon

description: OpenAI Chief Scientist has argued in a new blog post that Perplexity should be adopted as a shared metric to evaluate AI progress. Specifically, the Perplexity metric measures how well an AI can predict the next token on average. For this, a perplexity log value is established. Pachocki says that a lower perplexity value reflects better performance. Further, the AI scientist says that modern AI is being built by training a compressor on large datasets. A compressor performs compression by predicting the unseen data. Tracking the progress of compressors or other predictors can help in understanding how AI models are advancing, he argues. Earlier referred to as an “alien mind”, OpenAI’s Chief Scientist says that hard-to-predict emergent capabilities can be distinguished from the subsequent targeted elicitation.
title: OpenAI AI Scientist Argues for Establishing the Perplexity Metric to Evaluate the Performance of AI Models

description: South Korean cryptocurrency exchanges Upbit and Bithumb have suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals following reports of unexpected token minting on Solana and transfers from the Ethereum bridge contract. The Cyber project is investigating the activity and has urged users to avoid its bridge and refrain from depositing CYBER. Neither exchange has announced a timeline for restoring transfers.
title: Upbit and Bithumb Halt CYBER Transfers Over Suspected Bridge Exploit

description: The Vivo S70 series will be launched in China next month, the company has confirmed. The lineup has been in the rumour mill for quite some time, and it is expected to comprise the Vivo S70 and S70 Pro, which will arrive as the successors to the Vivo S60 series. Pre-orders for the Vivo S70 series have already begun in China, in anticipation of their debut. Separately, a tipster claims that the Vivo S70 series will have a dedicated photography accessory.
title: Vivo S70 Series China Launch Date Announced; Tipped to Come With Portrait Photography Accessory

description: iQOO 16 dedicated microsite was briefly made live in India, according to a tipster. The microsite was spotted on the Amazon India platform, which now appears to have been taken down. Further, it is shown to ship with Vivo’s latest OriginOS 7, which is based on Android 17. Recently, the iQOO India head, Nipun Marya, announced that the iQOO 16 will launch in India soon. However, the company has yet to announce the exact launch date. The phone is also confirmed to debut in the country with the flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset from Qualcomm, which is built on a 2nm process and delivers a peak clock speed of up to 5.01GHz. Apart from these details, the phone will sport the same design as its Chinese counterpart.
title: iQOO 16 Reportedly Appears on Amazon, Confirming India Launch: Expected Specifications

description: Bitcoin rebounded after touching around $55,100 over the weekend, as leveraged liquidations eased immediate selling pressure. However, continued withdrawals from US spot Bitcoin ETFs and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s interest rate outlook remain concerns. Investors are now watching the November 25 PCE inflation report for clues about the market’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Recovers Above Rs. 56.9 Lakh After Weekend Sell-Off as Liquidations Ease Selling Pressure

description: YouTube could soon give Android users more control over how its app looks on their home screens. The latest beta reportedly contains seven alternative icons, ranging from a monochrome version of the familiar play button to designs inspired by the platform's original logo and early iPhone app. References to a new setting in the app's General menu suggest users may eventually be able to switch between these designs. However, Google has yet to confirm the feature or clarify whether it will be widely available.
title: YouTube Reportedly Testing Alternative App Icons and Customisation Option on Android

description: WhatsApp is said to be working on expanding its view-once feature to text messages on iOS in beta. According to a feature tracker, the in-development functionality would allow users to send messages that disappear after the recipient opens and reads them. The feature reportedly carries several privacy restrictions, such as preventing recipients from taking screenshots, copying or forwarding the text. The feature is said to have started rolling out to some beta testers through the latest WhatsApp beta for iOS.
title: WhatsApp Said to Be Developing View-Once Text Messages With Screenshot Protection for iPhone

description: Samsung is said to be testing a redesigned Now Bar interface that could bring its live notifications closer to Apple's Dynamic Island experience. The changes have reportedly been spotted in One UI 9.5 software for the upcoming Galaxy S27 series. The new layout could introduce horizontal gestures to switch between ongoing activities. One UI 9.5 could also include a new Moment effects section with sports animations.
title: Samsung One UI 9.5 Update to Bring Dynamic Island-Like Design to Now Bar: Report

description: With smartphone prices increasing with every new launch cycle and even between releases, a report now claims that Samsung will raise prices for its Galaxy S27 series after releasing its Galaxy S26 series this year. The ballooning cost of rising memory prices has a different impact on Samsung as it also needs to tend to its AI infrastructure, born out of its AI services.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Could Cost More Than Galaxy S26 as Memory Prices Surge

description: Samsung will not launch a new Galaxy Watch model in 2027, according to a report. Samsung is reportedly changing the launch cycles for the Galaxy Watch models from annual to biennial. Hence, the new Samsung smartwatches could be launched every two years, with the Galaxy Watch 10 expected to debut in 2028. According to the report, Samsung decided to adjust the product cycle because it is restructuring the Mobile eXperience (MX) division. Samsung Electronics’ MX business has reportedly posted losses for two consecutive quarters this year. The report highlights that the move builds on the tech conglomerate’s recent push for profitability because of the ongoing RAM crisis. The company is said to have shifted its focus to premium lineups, while reducing production costs for the more affordable devices.
title: Samsung Will Reportedly Not Launch the Next-Generation Galaxy Watch Model in 2027: Here’s Why

description: Vivo S70 Pro is said to arrive with a 200-megapixel primary camera and support for an external teleconverter accessory. The handset is expected to debut in China as part of the company's S-series lineup and could eventually enter global markets as the Vivo V90 Pro. It is said to include a Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset and a 1.5K OLED display.
title: Vivo S70 Pro Specifications Leaked Online; Tipped to Get Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 SoC, 200-Megapixel Camera

description: With its iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, Apple also announced its first foldable phone called the iPhone Duo and wrapped up the current year with the launch of its premium iPhones. Since Apple completely skipped on its standard (non-Pro models), it was expected that Apple would launch these at a later date. A report now details a launch timeline for a bunch of affordable products, which includes the missing iPhone 18e and the iPhone 18.
title: Apple iPhone 18, iPhone 18e Launch Timeline Leaked; iPhone Air 2 Could Arrive Later

description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro models were launched in China recently, and the company is now preparing to introduce the standard Xiaomi 18. A tipster, however, claims that another handset could launch in the country as part of the Xiaomi 18 series. The Xiaomi 18 Max is tipped to be offered as a large-screen flagship smartphone. It will reportedly be powered by Qualcomm’s flagship Snapdragon chipset, while packing a battery larger than 8,000mAh.
title: Xiaomi 18 Max Tipped With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Chip, 8,000mAh-Plus Battery

description: Black Friday deals have been listed by Amazon on its platform in the US. The Google Pixel 11 Pro XL is listed at a discounted price of $899 (roughly Rs. 83,000), marking a discount of $400 (about Rs. 37,000). Similarly, customers can get a discount of $200 (roughly Rs. 19,000) with the Nothing Phone (3), which is currently available at a relatively low price of $499 (about Rs. 46,000). The Black Friday sale also brings a $200 discount on the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, offering the Fan Edition model at a discounted price of $499.99 (roughly Rs. 46,000). Apart from smartphones, Amazon has also listed TWS and tablets for the Black Friday sale event.
title: Black Friday Sale 2026: Top 10 Deals on Smartphones, Tablets and Earbuds from Apple, Samsung and More

description: OpenAI's ChatGPT mobile redesign separates its main chat interface, Dots AI agents and other tools into three navigation sections. The update also lets users pin frequently used features to the bottom bar and remove or replace shortcuts. ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 and above in supported regions are receiving access first, alongside a limited number of Plus subscribers. The rollout excludes the European Economic Area, the UK, Switzerland and South Korea. The redesigned interface is not supported on the iPhone SE, iPhone Duo or iPad.
title: ChatGPT Mobile App Gets Dedicated Dots Tab, Redesigned Navigation

description: The purported iQOO 16R has appeared on Geekbench with the model number Vivo I2606, scoring 1,775 points in single-core and 6,680 points in multi-core tests. The listing points to Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset, paired with 12GB of RAM and Android 17. The smartphone has also surfaced on India's BIS and Indonesia's TKDN certification platforms. It is tipped to feature a 6.59-inch AMOLED display, a 165Hz refresh rate, a 10,000mAh battery and an active cooling fan.
title: iQOO 16R Spotted on Geekbench With Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 SoC, Android 17

description: Apple will launch the next-generation MacBook Neo between February and March 2027, according to a report. Further, the laptop will reportedly be launched around the same time as the debut of the iPhone 18e and the new base iPad. Apart from this, the standard iPhone 18 model and the next-generation MacBook Air will reportedly be launched in the same time frame, in Spring next year. The first half of 2027 is said to also see the unveiling of the new iPad Air with an OLED display, next-generation iPad Pro, and the second-generation thin-and-light iPhone Air model. However, the report highlights that the new mid-tier iPad and iPhone models are “a little bit behind” the manufacturing schedule, unlike the iPhone 18e and MacBook Neo (2027).
title: Apple Plans to Launch the Next-Generation MacBook Neo in Spring 2027 Alongside iPhone 18e and New iPad: Report
